body:
Hi team,

Following up on my VM from this morning. We've got the Northstar RTV staged at door 41 -- store returns + salvage, mostly damaged POS display units and some shelving hardware that came back from stores. Northstar Manufacturing is paying for this move per their vendor return agreement (bill to Northstar, RA# RTV-135-20417).

Pick up: Big-Box DC135, 9800 Commerce Pkwy, Dallas TX 75241
Deliver: Northstar Manufacturing - Chicago Dock, Chicago IL
When: this Tue (11/17), any time after 0600. Live load, ~2 hrs
Freight: 18 pallets, roughly 14,200 lbs total, all shrink wrapped, nothing hazardous. Std 53' dry van is fine
Driver MUST have a seal, our gate is strict about it. Northstar's PO for the move is 4471882 if you need it.

Can you get me a price today? Trying to get this off the dock before weekend volume hits.

Thanks
Tasha Greer
Reverse Logistics Coordinator | Big-Box Retailer DC135
972-555-0141

-----Original Message-----
From: Tasha Greer
Sent: Thursday, November 12, 2026 4:02 PM
Subject: returns pickup DC135 -> Chicago
